title: Deck the Halls

    To StartChristmas lights caprese skewersTomato and bocconcini skewers, strung like Buddy's lightsHow to make it1 bunch basil60ml olive oil12 baby bocconcinis, halved250g cherry tomatoes1 bottle balsamic glaze1 tsp sea salt flakesBlitz some basil leaves with the oil and a pinch of salt, then strain.Halve the bocconcini.Thread skewers with a cherry tomato, a basil leaf and a bocconcini half, then another tomato.Lay them in rows on a long platter like strings of lights. Drizzle with basil oil and balsamic glaze and finish with cracked pepper and sea salt.Atomic Warlord cranberry chilli meatballsBaked beef and pork meatballs glazed in cranberry sweet chilli sauceHow to make it300g beef mince200g pork mince1 egg40g breadcrumbs1 garlic clove, crushed200g cranberry sauce3 tbsp sweet chilli sauce1 tbsp soy sauce1 lemon, juiced2 spring onions, slicedMix the minces with the egg, breadcrumbs, garlic and salt.Roll into small balls and bake on a lined tray at 200°C.Simmer the cranberry sauce, sweet chilli, soy and lemon juice until glossy.Toss the meatballs through, scatter with spring onion and serve on toothpicks.MainsFeud's-over turkey with cranberry glazeRoast turkey with orange cranberry glaze, cooked by Steve and Buddy togetherHow to make it1.5kg turkey breast90g butter150g cranberry sauce1 orange, juiced1 tbsp honey150g breadcrumbs1 onion, diced1 small bunch sage, chopped1 egg1kg potatoes3 tbsp vegetable oil300g green beansRub the turkey with some of the butter and salt.Roast at 180°C.Simmer the cranberry sauce with the orange juice and honey and brush over the turkey for the last part of the roasting.Fry the onion, mix with the breadcrumbs, sage, egg and melted butter and bake in a dish. Roast the potatoes in oil alongside.Toss the beans in butter and serve.Steve Finch's perfect roast potatoesPar-boiled, roughed up, roasted crisp. Steve plans it to the minuteHow to make it1.2kg floury potatoes, peeled and quartered80ml vegetable oil6 garlic cloves, unpeeled3 sprigs of rosemaryHeat the oil in a roasting tin at 220°C.Boil the potatoes in salted water for 8 minutes, drain and shake in the pot to rough up the edges.Tip into the hot oil, turn to coat and roast, turning once, until deep golden.Add the garlic and rosemary for the last 10 minutes, then salt well.Something SweetCul-de-sac Christmas trifleSponge, jelly, custard and cream. Matching sweaters for the card photoHow to make it1 packet strawberry jelly crystals300g sponge cake100ml orange juice250g mixed berries600ml thick vanilla custard300ml thickened cream1 tbsp icing sugar40g crushed honeycombMake up the jelly with boiling water and cool.Break the sponge into a glass bowl, drizzle with orange juice and add the berries. Pour over the jelly.Chill until set.Spoon over the custard.Whip the cream with the icing sugar and spread on top. Scatter with honeycomb just before serving.To DrinkNeighbourly vanilla eggnogChilled vanilla nog with nutmeg, for the WinterFest skating raceHow to make it4 eggs (yolks only)100g caster sugar700ml full cream milk200ml thickened cream1 cinnamon stick1 tsp vanilla extract1 whole nutmegWhisk the yolks with the sugar.Heat the milk, cream, cinnamon and vanilla until steaming, then slowly whisk into the yolks.Return to the pan and stir over low heat until it coats a spoon.Strain and chill.Pour into glasses and grate fresh nutmeg over the top.Hot spiced apple juice with cinnamonSteve's advent calendar says it's time.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
